I read the installed es-toolkit 1.53.2 declarations and sources. This is what I used:

| Function | Import | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `tokens` | `words` from `es-toolkit` | Splits the same way lodash does on the cases I ran by hand. |

| `toLookup` | `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat` | The main package has no `fromPairs`, so this is the only es-toolkit function that preserves the behaviour. |

- **Untested:** I didn't run `groupBy` or `fromPairs`.
